checklist.details: Voltage and current data extracted from CS2_36, NASA, and Oxford datasets.

checklist.step: Multi-parameter search space defined by Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS)
checklist.details: Scipy's qmc.LatinHypercube utilized to generate 4000 parameter combinations.
A simplified surrogate ECAT model implemented due to the complexity of full P2D models.
Scikit-Learn's MLPRegressor trained on LHS dataset to predict voltage curves.
Scipy's differential_evolution utilized to minimize RMSE between ANN predictions and experimental data.
